role: final judge — verification audit of rounds 1–4
verdict: PARTIAL-DISAGREE — round 1 and round 3 claims agree with the checked artifacts; round 2 is partial because both installed tools can certify pushed from a local-only master ref; round 4 is partial because the read-only rail was breached by the adversarial harness.

round_verdicts.basis: Summary and census counts match: 64/64 fragments, 246 rows, 160 SAFE and 86 NOT-SAFE.

Installed tool identity and current probes match the reported winner; however, no remote-tracking refs exist locally and both scripts emit SAFE(pushed) from refs/heads/master. That ref cannot establish that a commit was pushed.
96 unique approval rows all record origin/master ancestry; summary records 15 already-removed no-ops. Current worktree listing retains the three pinned gd2d registrations as prunable metadata.

Winner identity is confirmed, but the claim that the vault remained read-only throughout conflicts with the xtrace and recorded .obsidian config retimestamps. Notes and the live ledger remained unchanged.

defects_found.finding: Both installed verifiers can return SAFE(pushed) when the only candidate ref is local refs/heads/master. On this lane, refs/remotes/origin is empty, yet the tools returned SAFE(pushed) for their own installed files with ref=refs/heads/master. This is an unverified-push false positive risk, not proof that those specific commits were not pushed. The binding spec itself mandates the local-master fallback.

Both stale-reference sweeps use rg -l --no-ignore over the repo and exclude .git/census/tests/quarantine patterns but no secret-shaped filenames. A stale check for a benign target can therefore read unrelated .env/credential/secret/id_*/pem files. Static code-path finding only; this audit did not execute the sweep or read secret contents.

The S53 adversarial harness launched the Obsidian GUI via backtick command substitution while constructing a message. Xtrace records `++ obsidian`; S58 records .obsidian/appearance.json, app.json, and core-plugins.json retimestamps at 14:10:31. The recorded blast radius is config-only: 58 markdown notes unchanged and live ledger header-only. Current harness contains a backtick self-audit and GUI guard.
